{{Top|leg}}
A '''gravity assist''', also known as a '''gravitational slingshot''' or a '''swing-by''', was when a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] traveling at [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight speeds]] used the natural [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] forces of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and other celestial bodies to allow the ship to change speed or trajectory. It was a practical way to conserve energy, [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] expenses and [[Time/Legends|time]]. Gravity assists were commonly used for decelerating when arriving into planetary [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and also to decelerate through a planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].

[[Star/Legends|Stars]] can also be used for gravity assists to greatly magnify a ship's thrusting power. This solar slingshot however, was dangerous, as the ship would need to divert all its power to the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], lest the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] expose themselves to extremely high levels of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]].
